text_block_list.text:
That day, many horse girls took part in 
the swimming tournament held at Bubbly 
Land.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is on a much bigger scale than I 
thought. And you can feel serious 
competitive vibes everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This might turn out quite entertaining. I 
did not expect so many formidable 
contenders to gather here. Including 
yourself, correct? Ramonu-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Strength is always demonstrated by 
results. ...Any further words would be 
unrefined.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What an alluring... clash... No, if I look 
any longer... it's going to overflow...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Top contenders everywhere I look... But! 
Even so, the one who takes 1st place will 
be me...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The "Water Polo Throw" is heating up! Next 
up to throw is contestant Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh... Take thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! She has completely shattered 
the records of the tight pack, pulling far 
ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufun, how do you like that...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh, it appears to be my turn.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Contestant Gentildonna throws with 
incredible force! It's flying, it's 
soaring! This looks like another massive 
record!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, unbelievable!! She has surpassed 
Daiwa Scarlet's record yet again—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Event 5 is the High Dive! The horse girls 
continue to put on a show of magnificent 
dives!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've got the highest score so far. My 
rotations were spot on, too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's fine... Nobody's going to beat me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Shall we?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu's diving form is simply exquisite! 
And so many rotations! Just what score 
will she receive?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's record just got beat, 
already?! Though man, that was too close 
to call~ Tough luck!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Event 8 is the Beach Plank Run! Just how 
far can they make it across the floating 
boards lined up on the water?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure! Absolutely! In a 
landslide!! HYAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, she crossed the entire 
distance! An unexpected total clear! Even 
the organizers didn't see this coming!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I shouldn't... When you show me 
such fierce intensity... The throbbing 
inside just won't subside... Ahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love has burst from the start at 
unbelievable speed! She's darting across 
like a ninja!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
We have yet another finisher! And her 
clearing time was distinctly faster!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the victor of the Beach Plank Run 
is Still in Love!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now for a special award! To Daiwa Scarlet, 
who showed outstanding performance across 
every single event, we present the 
Fighting Spirit Award!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
To close out the tournament, we'll finish 
with a victory swim by all our award 
recipients! Daiwa Scarlet, you too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(What do you mean, 'Fighting Spirit 
Award'...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I don't care about something like that... 
Unless I'm number one... it doesn't 
count...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
D-Daiwa Scarlet...?! Look at the raw 
spirit in her swimming! She's flying 
through the water!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for putting on such an incredible 
show at the very end!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, my... What a delightful girl.

Seeing Daiwa Scarlet surrounded by 
cheering spectators, I couldn't help but 
call out to her.
choice_data_list: Your heart was definitely number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well of course it was! That's the bare 
minimum.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm... capable of so much more 
than this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
These feelings... I'll engrave them deep 
into my heart so I never forget.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm definitely taking the win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I suppose... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If there's a next time, I won't just have 
number-one drive—I'm going to take number 
one in the actual results!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I truly feel the same way about myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why next time, I'm going 
out there purely to win. No matter who 
stands in my way!
